assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines), ownership, municipal utilities and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: All such indicators are recorded unknown; the package is reviewable only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional (official_boundary=false) until official polygons are published.
assumptions.impact: site boundary, key areas, land use, roads, green space, public space, buildings, phasing and all spatial metrics must be recomputed when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Existing building stock, ownership, road redlines and municipal data are not in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish conclusions are limited to method and concept massing; statutory conclusions are excluded.
